prohibited_changes: Do not replace the user-supplied indicator with a reconstruction.

object_budget.policy: FIFO-delete finalized drawings beyond the configured bounded history; draw at most 100 concurrent active setups while continuing to track every active record; never add plot-count calls for setup or sweep evidence

visual_requirements: Show premium-discount direction separately from structural bias.
Keep HTF structure visually stronger than LTF execution structure.
Anchor sweep labels to the swept level and expose active, consumed, or invalid state.
Show bounded historical confirmed manipulations and setups in production mode.
Expose noisy pivot and lifecycle internals only in debug mode.
Show frozen long or short pending-setup position drawings only from their confirmed readiness bar.
Expose candidate and invalidated sweeps only in audit mode.
Show HTF source time separately from the later chart bar where it became known.
Keep the dense checklist dashboard available for corroboration but disabled by default so production price action and position drawings remain readable.

review_timeframes.purpose: Confirmed 4h ownership, range, premium-discount, 71% audit, sweep lifecycle and visual preservation
4h context plus repaired 15m execution structure, 67% audit, sweep lifecycle and break-linked FVG

hard_rules.rule: A confirmed body-close BOS or CHoCH must be produced by an impulsive move containing accepted directional imbalance.
The post-break trading-range endpoint must be confirmed before the Fibonacci and setup parameters are frozen.
The canonical intraday model uses 67% entry, 100% stop, and 0% target on the locked 15-minute range.
Only completed 4-hour context and confirmed 15-minute events may own a setup; readiness is timestamped at the first close where all hard and conditional gates coincide.

conditional_rules.rule: A reversal/CHoCH requires a previously purged liquidity level confirmed after the opposite structural break.
A BOS continuation may remain valid without a fresh liquidity purge.

quality_grades.rule: Exact or close 67%/FVG alignment is A-plus confluence, not base validity.
Pro-trend versus counter-trend 4-hour context is disclosed as risk context and does not veto an otherwise valid 15-minute entry.

isolated_alternative.rule: The later 71% sweep-required swing model is measured separately and cannot silently replace the canonical 67% intraday model.
